subject: Proposal: deferred ramp + term incentive for 3-year commitment (Cloudwave)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Selina Ortiz <selina@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: deferred ramp + term incentive for 3-year commitment (Cloudwave)

Hi Selina —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Per our conversation, I attached an initial commercial structure that attempts to meet Cloudwave's ask for: (a) an off-cycle ramp in year 1, (b) split billing options, and (c) an enterprise-level effective discount across a 36‑month commitment. Key points in the attachment (Pricing_Model_3yr_v3.xlsx):

- Term: 36 months; annual invoicing by default but option to split into 3 annual invoices.
- Year 1 ramp: 40% of committed units billed in Q1, 80% in Q2, then full runrate by Q4. We can take a deferred billing approach on the first invoice (60 days) to align with Cloudwave's cash cadence.
- Pricing: baseline list price with a tiered term incentive that increases with on‑time signature and ramp milestones — target effective discount ~18% if ramp milestones are met (detailed on tab "RampMilestones").
- Performance credits: small SLA credit pool tied to latency SLOs; finance prefers credits over upfront refunds.

I've cc'd Marcus to keep him in the loop on the financials. If this looks directionally right, I can route for formal approval and draft an SOW (I can attach a placeholder SOW for signature).

Attachments: Pricing_Model_3yr_v3.xlsx

Next step: Would you be open to a short 30‑minute call Wednesday to walk the numbers and confirm the billing cadence?

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0127 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com
From: Selina Ortiz <selina@cloudwave.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: deferred ramp + term incentive for 3-year commitment (Cloudwave)

Tessa —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the model. Two quick clarifications from Cloudwave leadership/finance:

1) Split billing: we prefer quarterly invoicing for Y1 to spread cash; annual is ok for Y2/Y3. Is that feasible?
2) Ramp credits: the 18% looks great on paper but our CFO wants stronger protection if actual usage misses ramp — can we add a usage‑based clawback mechanism (credits in year 2 if year 1 falls below 65% of committed units)?
3) Deferred billing: 60 days is workable but we'd prefer invoice on receipt with Net 60 payment terms (so payment due 60 days from invoice date).

If you can send a revised SOW with quarterly invoice option and the proposed clawback language, we can take to legal. Would also like to get internal approval on signature authority before we schedule another call.

Thanks,
Selina Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships, Cloudwave
selina@cloudwave.io
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Cloudwave - pricing clarifications and requested contract language

Team —

Forwarding Cloudwave's reply (below). They want: quarterly billing in Y1 (then annual), Net 60 payment terms, and a usage‑based clawback that pushes some credits into Y2 if Y1 usage < 65% of committed. They also asked for stronger protection in the event of under‑delivery.

Ask: can finance/legal approve (a) quarterly invoicing in Y1, (b) Net 60 on invoices (we accept), and (c) a clawback that scales credits up to an additional 6% of ARR in year 2 if ramp misses? I've attached the pricing model and a draft SOW placeholder.

If we can accommodate this with a conditional milestone structure (i.e., credits triggered automatically based on metered usage), I think we can hold on to the 18% effective discount target; otherwise we'll need to pull back to ~12–14% effective.

Attachments: Pricing_Model_3yr_v3.xlsx, Cloudwave_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Tessa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cloudwave - pricing clarifications and requested contract language

Tessa —

Thanks for the context and the model. High level: finance is open to supporting quarterly invoicing in year 1 and Net 60 terms, but we need clear triggers for the clawback and a maximum liability cap. A few notes from my review: 

- Quarterly invoicing (Y1) is acceptable provided we keep the total committed invoiced amount on schedule (we will not accept extended collectability risk beyond Net 60).
- Clawback mechanism: suggest a tiered credit schedule rather than a linear clawback. Proposed: if Y1 usage < 65% of committed, credit 3% of total contract value in Y2; if <50%, credit 6% in Y2. This matches what you proposed but with discrete bands.
- Liability cap: cap cumulative credits at 6% of contracted value across the term. No cash refunds, credits only, per standard policy.
- SLA credits: keep them separate (operational). Do not tie SLA credits to ramp protection.

Marcus — please confirm that offering these credits and Net 60 does not create an SLA/revenue recognition issue for your team. Also flag any concerns about the effective discount moving below threshold if the clawback is triggered; legal will want consistent definitions for "committed units" and "usage" (metering).

If you agree, I can approve the commercial with the tiered credit schedule and signature delegation to Selina up to the negotiated cap; we should still route final SOW to legal for the exact language.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Selina Ortiz <selina@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: deferred ramp + term incentive for 3-year commitment (Cloudwave)

Selina —

Appreciate the clarity and the path forward. Per internal approvals (cc'd Marcus and Laura), please see an updated commercial summary and next steps below. I attached a redlined SOW for review.

Summary (revised):
- Term: 36 months.
- Billing cadence: Quarterly invoicing in Year 1 (invoice on receipt); Year 2 and 3 invoicing annual by default (we can make annual splitable on request).
- Payment terms: Net 60 from invoice date.
- Ramp/clawback: tiered credit schedule — if Y1 actual usage < 65% of committed units => 3% credit applied in Y2; if < 50% => 6% credit in Y2. Credits are account-level service credits (no cash refunds).
- Liability cap: total credits capped at 6% of contracted value over the term.
- Effective discount: conditional 18% if milestones met; in the event of clawback the realized effective discount will adjust as outlined in the attached pricing model.
- SLA: separate operational credit pool remains unchanged.

Attachments: Cloudwave_SOW_v1.pdf, Pricing_Model_3yr_v3.xlsx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign?envelopeId=Cloudwave-3yr-2027

Next steps:
1) Please confirm that the tiered credit schedule and Net 60 terms are acceptable to Cloudwave finance/legal.
2) If OK, sign the attached SOW (DocuSign link above). Once counter‑signed, finance will issue first invoice per the agreed cadence and we will schedule a kickoff.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you'd like to walk through the redlines before legal review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0127
